ValidationRule.description: When complaint remedy is set to product manufacturer then financial amount cant be edited
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Setup.Salesforce_Library_Settings__c.Disable_VRs__c = false, NOT(ISNEW()), OR( RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Non_Customer_Complaint', RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Customer_Complaint' ), ISPICKVAL(IDR_Complaint_Remedy__c, '3'), ISCHANGED(IDR_Financial_Compensation__c) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Financial Amount cannot be updated if the complaint remedy is referred to product manufacturer
